patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-fashion editorial imagery is used extensively for hero and collection showcases, creating a magazine-like visual impact.
Content sections frequently alternate between large, impactful single images or split images and structured product grids or carousels.
A distinct serif logotype contrasts with a clean, uppercase sans-serif for navigation and section titles, conveying a modern yet established brand identity.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of black, white, and off-white dominates, allowing product photography to introduce the primary color accents.
An initial welcome overlay appears on page load, which can be dismissed by user interaction or scrolling, revealing the main content.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, ensuring constant access as the user scrolls down the page.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the screen during scroll. Initial content, like a welcome message, is presented in a modal overlay that can be closed or automatically dismissed upon user interaction or scroll. Product displays leverage a carousel system (swiper) for horizontal scrolling of items. Sections and individual elements likely use CSS keyframes or transitions to subtly fade or slide into view as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reveal effect during scrolling.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3x body) are used for section titles, while body text and navigation are smaller, regular-weight sans-serif. The brand logo uses a distinct, elegant serif.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical and horizontal padding around major content blocks and within editorial sections, creating a premium feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its strong editorial aesthetic, blending high-quality, full-bleed fashion photography with a clean, minimalist layout. It feels less like a typical e-commerce site and more like an interactive fashion magazine, effectively showcasing collections with impactful visuals rather than just product listings.
